scenarios.name: Refresh replaces an unchanged nil cache using fresh local capabilities
scenarios.given: saved unchanged conversations previously produced no local vectors
scenarios.when: the user explicitly refreshes local History search after Apple assets become usable
scenarios.then: the same index owner re-embeds unchanged records with a fresh adapter even with the same recipe, preserves original conversation values and retains ordinary incremental reuse on normal saves

scenarios.name: Delete and newer work win over a held refresh
scenarios.given: an explicit local refresh or earlier answer is held
scenarios.when: the conversation is deleted, history cleared or current work replaces it
scenarios.then: deleted vectors and obsolete answers cannot return; storage failure retains exact-word search and can retry

scenarios.name: Explicit local Refresh is usable on Mac and phone History
scenarios.given: History is open on Mac or iPhone with saved synthetic conversations
scenarios.then: the actual shared control owns one local attempt and returns to normal idle or retains a retryable failure; literal results remain reachable without asset requests or provider dispatch; the test reports installed versus unavailable Apple branch without a language-quality claim

scenarios.name: A surviving conversation is rebuilt after a deletion interrupts Refresh
scenarios.given: an explicit refresh has cleared old derived vectors and is held on the first of two conversations
scenarios.when: that first conversation is deleted before its held inference returns
scenarios.then: Refresh reconciles the current archive before returning ready, the surviving conversation is Related and supplies Ask evidence, and the deleted one cannot return

scenarios.name: No-results guidance leaves local Refresh reachable
scenarios.given: phone History contains saved fixture conversations and an unmatched query shows no-results guidance
scenarios.when: the user activates Refresh search through that same History screen
scenarios.then: no-results guidance is laid out after Ask and its disclosure without overlap; the actual Refresh control is hittable and can return to idle without losing the query or showing an alert; the no-results state and its control remain visible

scenarios.name: Older queued indexing cannot undo the current archive rebuilt by Refresh
scenarios.given: Refresh is held while an older full sync or saved text is queued behind it
scenarios.when: the current archive gains a conversation or receives newer text before Refresh resumes
scenarios.then: older maintenance cannot remove the newly reconciled conversation or replace its current semantic excerpts; Related and Ask use the current saved evidence before the next save debounce

scenarios.name: Fresh History previews show the actual control and literal result without keyboard overlays
scenarios.given: the synthetic native History screen has an exact-word result for a short query
scenarios.when: the refreshed History view is captured for the README gallery
scenarios.then: the actual Refresh control and matching result are hittable, the software keyboard is dismissed and no alert covers the preview

scenarios.name: Empty History keeps local Refresh reachable
scenarios.given: the user has cleared the synthetic fixture archive and sees no saved conversations
scenarios.when: Refresh search is activated from that same History screen
scenarios.then: the control remains hittable and returns to idle while empty guidance remains and Ask is absent

scenarios.name: Recovery guidance stays legible in the actual Mac control
scenarios.given: a local History refresh fails on the native Aqua card surface
scenarios.when: the actual shared control renders its recovery caption below the button
scenarios.then: the opaque native caption glyphs meet the existing 4.5:1 small-text contrast benchmark while the retry action remains usable

scenarios.name: Reach History controls and open a matching conversation across adaptive landscape phone and iPad layouts
scenarios.given: the synthetic prototype conversation is shown at default text size on a compact or larger landscape iPhone Duo workspace, or an iPad using Duo or the full wide workspace according to its available space
scenarios.when: History search is revealed by a normal downward scroll if needed, a prototype query is entered, Refresh search completes, an ordinary upward scroll exposes the matching record even when it only slightly overlaps Search, the record is tapped, and normal History is reopened
scenarios.then: Refresh, Ask and the provider disclosure are accessible before scrolling; Refresh preserves the query and result; the complete selected record is reachable without search-field obstruction and tapping it opens the matching title and transcript; reopened unqueried History shows unobscured Refresh and the complete record in its native gallery capture; queried phase captures remain separate QA evidence and this sequential flow does not require every control to fit simultaneously
